title: More Than One
label: ch:bn-more-than-one
canDo: I can sort a noun into living or not, put the plural its group demands on it, and stand an adjective in front of it.

payoff.summary: One question about a noun — is it alive? — chooses between two plural endings, and every noun the book owns goes through the one its group demands. The adjective rule that thirty-two chapters used without stating is stated.
payoff.note: গুলো had zero occurrences in 139 files and every raw match for রা was a substring of another word. A learner who owned four family words and five colours could not say more than one of any of them.
